verdict.rationale: Both make the same code change: skip blank or whitespace-only lines in `parse_entries` while keeping line numbering from `enumerate`. B is slightly better on tests and verification. Its two focused tests separately check skipping, including multiple entries around the blanks, and line numbering after a blank line. B also ran the full suite, and its 20-test count is consistent with the repository. A ran only the importer tests, and its single test mixes two concerns.
a_issues: The single test combines the skip check and the line-number check, and the success case yields only one entry, so it is a weaker check that entries after a blank line are still parsed.
Only the importer tests were run. The CLI tests were not run, although the import path is exercised end to end there.
